basis: empirical pseudo-out-of-sample error dispersion, by within-quarter information stage (jt = n_months_in_quarter); post-COVID target quarters only (>= 2022-01-01). Pre-2020 errors are significantly tighter (F=2.97, p<0.0001) so pooling them would understate current uncertainty.
method: interval = point - bias_applied +/- t(df) * sd, where bias_applied is 0 unless the stage's bias is significant at the 5% level. Stages with fewer than MIN_N observations fall back to `pooled`.
